page: Google Cloud Platform h4d-megamem-192-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the h4d family. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The system is equipped with 3024.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 15.75 GB per core.

This server configuration includes integrated local storage consisting of 32 NVMe SSDs, delivering a total of 12885 GB of local storage capacity. There are no GPUs bundled with this instance type, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the massive memory capacity and substantial local NVMe SSD storage, this instance is designed for memory-intensive and storage-heavy enterprise workloads. It offers qualitative cost efficiency by consolidating large-scale databases and in-memory applications onto a single physical host, reducing the overhead of distributed nodes. Appropriate workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, real-time data analytics, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy transactional database engines.
